rules: Long only, on the app's swing labels. The sequence starts with an LH. Stage from the latest confirmed labels: LH, HH = HH1; LH, HH, HL = HL1; LH, HH, HL, HH = HH2 (a swing is confirmed 5 bars after its pivot). Entry 1 (assumed rule) = first 3-rule candle while the stage is HL1. Entry 2 = first 3-rule candle that closes below HH2's close while the stage is HH2; (a) only when an Entry 1 came first, (b) every Entry 2. Entry at the next bar's open. No exits: the return is measured N bars later, after a 0.2% round-trip cost. Win = return above 0. Replayed without hindsight on today's stock list. Groups under 30 signals are not reliable. Past results do not predict future performance.
